name: Builtin Cluster: Cross-Sectional Variants (group_by=none)
description: Tests: cs_rank, cs_zscore(group_by=none), cs_agg(type=all 18 × group_by=none), cs_select(direction=bottom, mode=percent), cs_quantile(group_by=none), cs_weighted_mean(group_by=none), cs_first_last(group_by=none), cs_factor_analysis(method=kendall/pearson/spearman), cs_momentum(group_by=none). Multi-asset cross-sectional operations.
source:
# =============================================================================
# BUILTIN CLUSTER: Cross-Sectional Variants (group_by=none)
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
volume = src.v

ret = returns()(close)
ret_21 = returns(period=21)(close)

# === CS RANK ===
ranked = cs_rank()(ret_21)

# === CS ZSCORE ===
zs = cs_zscore(group_by=AssetGroupingMode.none)(ret_21)

# === CS AGG: All 18 AggregationType variants (group_by=none) ===
agg_sum = cs_agg(type=AggregationType.Sum, group_by=AssetGroupingMode.none)(ret)
agg_mean = cs_agg(type=AggregationType.Mean, group_by=AssetGroupingMode.none)(ret)
agg_median = cs_agg(type=AggregationType.Median, group_by=AssetGroupingMode.none)(ret)
agg_std = cs_agg(type=AggregationType.Std, group_by=AssetGroupingMode.none)(ret)
agg_var = cs_agg(type=AggregationType.Var, group_by=AssetGroupingMode.none)(ret)
agg_min = cs_agg(type=AggregationType.Min, group_by=AssetGroupingMode.none)(ret)
agg_max = cs_agg(type=AggregationType.Max, group_by=AssetGroupingMode.none)(ret)
agg_count = cs_agg(type=AggregationType.Count, group_by=AssetGroupingMode.none)(ret)
agg_first = cs_agg(type=AggregationType.First, group_by=AssetGroupingMode.none)(ret)
agg_last = cs_agg(type=AggregationType.Last, group_by=AssetGroupingMode.none)(ret)
agg_prod = cs_agg(type=AggregationType.Product, group_by=AssetGroupingMode.none)(ret)
agg_q = cs_agg(type=AggregationType.Quantile, group_by=AssetGroupingMode.none)(ret)
agg_skew = cs_agg(type=AggregationType.Skew, group_by=AssetGroupingMode.none)(ret)
agg_kurt = cs_agg(type=AggregationType.Kurtosis, group_by=AssetGroupingMode.none)(ret)
agg_all = cs_agg(type=AggregationType.All, group_by=AssetGroupingMode.none)(ret > 0)
agg_any = cs_agg(type=AggregationType.Any, group_by=AssetGroupingMode.none)(ret > 0)
agg_cd = cs_agg(type=AggregationType.CountDistinct, group_by=AssetGroupingMode.none)(ret > 0)
agg_mode = cs_agg(type=AggregationType.Mode, group_by=AssetGroupingMode.none)(ret > 0)

# === CS SELECT: bottom + percent ===
sel_bottom = cs_select(direction=CSSelectDirection.bottom, mode=CSSelectMode.percent, k=20, group_by=AssetGroupingMode.none)(ret_21)

# === CS QUANTILE ===
cs_q = cs_quantile(q=0.5, group_by=AssetGroupingMode.none)(ret_21)

# === CS WEIGHTED MEAN ===
cs_wm = cs_weighted_mean(group_by=AssetGroupingMode.none)(ret_21, volume)

# === CS FIRST/LAST ===
cs_fl = cs_first_last(group_by=AssetGroupingMode.none)(ret)

# === CS FACTOR ANALYSIS: all 3 correlation methods ===
factor = sma(period=50)(close)
fa_k = cs_factor_analysis(method=CorrelationMethod.kendall)(ret_21, factor)
fa_p = cs_factor_analysis(method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(ret_21, factor)
fa_s = cs_factor_analysis(method=CorrelationMethod.spearman)(ret_21, factor)

# === CS MOMENTUM (group_by=none — base already covered) ===
mom_none = cs_momentum(group_by=AssetGroupingMode.none)(ret)

# === REPORTERS ===
cs_lines(
    title='CS Rank (21d returns)',
    category='CS Ranking'
)(x_values=index(), y_values=ranked)

cs_lines(
    title='CS Z-Score (21d returns)',
    category='CS Stats'
)(x_values=index(), y_values=zs)

cs_lines(
    title='CS Agg Mean Return',
    category='CS Aggregation'
)(x_values=index(), y_values=agg_mean)
